title: Ancient Egypt Tomb Builder Game - Insane difference from Sonnet 3.5!
author: CommercialShelter595
selftext:
I've had this idea for an **ancient Egypt tomb building/tower defence game** for a long time now. I've always loved those **3D views of the tombs in the valley of the kings** and thought it'd be fun to be able to construct my own tomb and look at it as it repels waves of intruders.

Fable nailed the look and feel in just a few quick shots. I asked it for a few mockups to choose from and chose something with the modern architect blue background. The next few prompts were to build out how I felt the game should play. Fable 5 got this game very far with a handful of prompts.

I've since polished it, mainly with Claude Code, some Codex as well. Lots of it is balance and text. The biggest adds on features is a monte carlo simulation for balance, and adding a story mode rather than only an endless mode. I've also experimented with some silly forks like where intruders killed make a splat noise or marines dying from StarCraft.

For fun, this is what Claude Artifacts (Sonnet 3.5) came up with in June 2024: [https://ibb.co/2YmrLDy3](https://ibb.co/2YmrLDy3). I had a different workflow back then, and so the prompts are a little different. The vision is largely the same though and this Claude Artifacts version had a bunch of polish added too. The images are AI generated placeholders, the logic needed to be worked several times over. It's crazy how much better AI got in just 2 years.

You can try the game live at [https://architectofthevalley.com/](https://architectofthevalley.com/)

I'm still playing around with it, so any ideas to make it better is very welcome!
